metadata.name: High Arctic Radiosonde Vertical Profile Ascent - August 18, 2018
metadata.description: Single low-altitude radiosonde ascent profile conducted in the high Arctic (near 89.56°N, 36.84°E) on August 18, 2018. The dataset contains 1,801 vertical atmospheric measurements captured over a 30-minute window (11:09–11:39 UTC), covering altitudes from ~6.6 m to ~706.8 m. Variables include atmospheric pressure (PPPP), temperature (TTT), relative humidity (RH), wind direction (dd), and wind speed (ff). Data quality is high with minimal missing values (2–3 rows per field).
